content: Monday-Friday 08:00-18:00; Saturday 09:00-13:00; Sunday closed. Times are local to the fictional Waiblingen branch.
ZaenDrive Demo Depot, Building A, Example Mobility Campus, Waiblingen, Germany. This is a fictional address for coursework, not a real pickup location.
Credit cards and debit cards are accepted at pickup. Cash and cryptocurrency are not accepted. Prices are in EUR.
In this fictional rental policy, drivers must be at least 21 and have held a valid driving licence for at least 2 years. This is a demo company rule, not legal advice.
Bring a valid driving licence, passport or national ID, and a payment card in the main driver's name. Questions about foreign licence acceptance must be checked with staff.

Petrol and diesel vehicles must be returned with a full tank. Electric vehicles must be returned with at least 80% battery charge. Refuelling and charging costs are excluded from quotes; additional fee amounts are not in this demo database.

Cancellation is free at least 48 hours before pickup. Later cancellations incur one day of the undiscounted base rental rate. Staff must handle cancellation requests; this demo cannot modify a reservation.
Contact staff before the agreed return time if you expect to be late. Exact late-return charges are not available in this database.
The assistant can provide information and quotes but cannot create, change or cancel a booking. Contact staff to request a reservation. The coursework contact is fictional.
The available flag is only a fixed demonstration snapshot. It does not represent a date-specific calendar. Ask staff to confirm a rental for specific dates.
Pickup and return take place at the fictional depot during opening hours. Short-term customer parking is available there. No one-way return service is offered.
The demo base price includes standard insurance. Excess amounts, exclusions, cross-border cover and optional coverage prices are not stored; refer these questions to staff.
Demo staff email: support@zaendrive.example. Staff hours: Monday-Friday 08:00-18:00 and Saturday 09:00-13:00. This example address does not reach a real service team; the app sends no messages.
